title: Restricted weight as a mean square
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $J$ be a finite set of coordinates, and let $S$ be a finite subset of $J$. The restricted Fourier weight of $f$ on $J$ at $S$ equals the uniform expectation, over sign assignments to the coordinates outside $J$, of the square of the corresponding Fourier coefficient of the restriction of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: real-valued function on the n-dimensional sign cube
